newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Reliance completes US$314 mln 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: Reliance completes US$314 mln 144A debt.

text.p: Reliance Industries Ltd's US$314 million Rule 144A two-tranche debt issue has been successfully completed, lead manager Merrill Lynch said on Thursday.
The issue consists of a US$100 million tranche of 10.25 percent notes due January 2097, and a US$214 million tranche of 8.25 percent notes due January 2027 with a put option in year 10.
The other lead manager is Morgan Stanley.

"Reliance is the first Asian corporate not government-controlled to issue century bonds, and is only the 19th corporate to ever issue such bonds. In addition, the 100 year maturity is the longest by any split rated Baa3/BB+ issuer", the statement said.
